sources.title: [2608.03701] LiLa-WAM: Lightweight Latent Reasoning World-Action Model ...
sources.snippet: The resulting training cost can make such methods difficult to train under modest computational budgets. In this work, we propose LiLa-WAM, a lightweight world-action model that reasons about the future in a compact latent space and can be trained end-to-end on a single 24GB GPU.

sources.title: LiLa-WAM: Lightweight Latent Reasoning World-Action Model for Robotic ...
sources.snippet: LiLa-WAM is a lightweight world-action model that reasons about the future in a compact latent space, trainable end-to-end on a single 24GB GPU, achieving 90.48% success across 50 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks.

sources.title: LiLa-WAM: Lightweight Latent Reasoning World-Action Model for Robotic ...
sources.snippet: LiLa-WAM shares the lightweight pursuit but differs fundamentally in formulation. It couples action generation with explicit future-state prediction in a compact latent space, so that foresight becomes a training signal rather than an emergent by-product.
